Relays product-discovery GET /products with the search filters q, categoryId, inStock, priceMin, priceMax, sort and the page parameters limit and cursor. An undeclared parameter answers 400 unknown-query-parameter; the answer is the provider's page \{items, facets, categorySuggestions, nextCursor\}.
